articles.title: California's Governor Primary Remains Undecided as Becerra and Hilton Lead a Crowded Field
articles.summary: California's primary for governor is too close to call, with Democrat Xavier Becerra and Republican Steve Hilton leading. Billionaire Tom Steyer trails closely. The top two finishers, regardless of party, will advance to November's general election.

articles.title: Trump Admits Calling Netanyahu 'Crazy' Amid Stalled Iran Peace Talks
articles.summary: President Trump acknowledged calling Israeli PM Netanyahu 'crazy' during a phone call, citing frustration that fighting in Lebanon is complicating Iran peace talks. Both leaders insist their relationship remains strong despite tactical disagreements.

articles.title: Brazil's Lula Rebukes U.S. Over Proposed 25% Tariffs, Citing Broken Detente
articles.summary: Brazilian President Lula da Silva condemned new U.S. tariffs of 25% on certain imports, saying he 'cannot accept the treatment.' The move appears to reverse a recent warming of relations after a White House meeting between Lula and Trump.
